Note: Drug set as in Figure 9 (59 drugs); six groups matching the six lanes of Figure 9; highest phase and registered trials from this review's trial registration dataset (ClinicalTrials.gov, cut-off 2026-10-20; 1 133 RAS-related phase 1–3 interventional oncology trials); registered trials: a measure of development activity, not efficacy, including trials with the drug only as a combination component, so counts overlap; scope: drugs acting on the RAS protein, upstream processing and regulatory nodes, and immune strategies against mutant-RAS neoantigens; gene therapies excluded except iExosome siG12D (human data available); avutometinib + defactinib (group 6): no direct RAS binding, included for its FDA indication defined by *KRAS* mutation; other downstream kinase inhibitors, ifebemtinib, anti-EGFR antibodies and cytotoxic drugs (combination partners or comparators) not listed; single-arm response rates with sample size and assessment method; approval information in Table 2. Abbreviations: CRC / mCRC, (metastatic) colorectal cancer; DCR, disease control rate; IRRC, independent radiology review committee; LGSOC, low-grade serous ovarian cancer; MTD, maximum tolerated dose; NSCLC, non-small-cell lung cancer; ORR, objective response rate; OS, overall survival; PFS, progression-free survival; TCR, T-cell receptor; TRAE, treatment-related adverse event; VAF, variant allele frequency.
